authority.reason_for_U2: U2 exists at dependency level 1; y_new is unavailable without completing the step and would defeat early admission semantics

definition.physical_component_prefix: i=1..m; exclude trailing time-augmentation clock component
definition.interpretation: admission diagnostic only; not a local-error theorem and not an estimator of final embedded error

dimension_and_units.rho_c2_wrms: dimensionless componentwise when atol has each component's state units
dimension_and_units.caveat: scalar atol assumes compatible state-component units or an already nondimensionalized state; arbitrary heterogeneous-unit vectors require vector atol support before generic promotion

diagnostic_work_to_count_separately: one WRMS accumulation over m physical components
one square root for the WRMS scalar

kill_tests: quadratic tolerance triplet must no longer have an exact rho_c2_wrms collision and score ordering must move monotonically with the adaptive error norm on that predeclared triplet
any numerical state/output/attempt-sequence/controller-history/existing-work-counter change stops the node
any added RHS/JVP/phi/Jacobian/Newton work stops the node
any unscorable canonical attempt stops the node
if a predeclared view is no better than all-admit under its complete threshold sweep, reject that use of the score rather than tuning around it

required: all-attempt complete threshold sweep and Pareto frontier
entry-window complete threshold sweep and Pareto frontier
